content: SemVer formally grants 0.x 'anything goes', but the dominant community convention is 0.INCOMPATIBLE.COMPATIBLE: a source-breaking change on a 0.x line takes a MINOR bump, never a PATCH. Pandas-style policy: introduce deprecation aliases in a minor release with a warning naming the removal version; removing without a deprecation window strands consumers. For dataclass field renames specifically there is no runtime deprecation hook (attribute access is not interceptable on frozen+slots dataclasses without a property shim), so the mitigation is a changelog callout plus an explicit old->new migration table.
